full_prompt_en: A square sepia studio photograph shows four women in patterned long robes posed together beneath large paper parasols. The background is a softly painted interior backdrop with a pale center and dark architectural forms near the edges, giving the group a staged but atmospheric setting. Two broad parasols open above the left side, their narrow ribs radiating from dark hubs and their rounded edges overlapping the backdrop. The women stand close together across the middle of the frame, facing the camera with restrained expressions. Their dark hair is arranged up and away from the face, and each robe carries a different arrangement of dense floral or curving marks. Wide sleeves hang near their hands, and broad sashes gather the garments at the waist. The figure on the far left turns slightly inward, with fabric trailing toward the lower-left corner. Beside her, a darker robe forms a strong vertical mass under one parasol. The two figures on the right wear lighter patterned fabrics, with the far-right garment descending in broad pale folds to the floor. One of them holds a parasol whose circular form rises behind her head and shoulders. Along the lower edge, a dark shallow platform or floor supports the aligned feet and the hems of the robes. The photograph's surface has fine grain, slightly faded highlights, and softly compressed shadow detail, while robe motifs and parasol ribs retain delicate definition. Light falls broadly from the front-left, brightening faces and pale cloth, and the outer edges sink into warm brown shade. The overall composition is formal and carefully balanced, using repeated circular parasols and richly textured vertical garments within a narrow range of brown, cream, and charcoal.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形棕褐色影棚照片呈现四位身穿带花纹长袍的女子，在大纸伞下并排摆姿势。背景是一幅柔和绘制的室内布景，中部较浅，边缘有深色建筑形状，使合影既有布置感，也带些气氛。左侧上方撑着两把宽大的纸伞，细密伞骨从深色中心向外辐射，圆弧边缘与背景互相重叠。女子们在画面中部紧靠站立，面向镜头，神情克制。深发都向上整理，露出面部，每件长袍都有不同的密集花纹或弯曲图案。宽袖垂在手边，宽腰带在腰间束起衣服。最左边的人略向内转身，布料一直拖向左下角。她身旁，一件较深的长袍在一把纸伞下形成有力的竖向体块。右侧两人穿较浅的花纹布料，最右边的衣服以大片浅色褶皱垂到地面。其中一人持伞，圆形伞面从她头肩后方升起。沿下缘，深色浅台面或地面支撑并列的脚和长袍下摆。照片表面有细颗粒、略褪色的亮部与柔和压缩的暗部细节，袍服纹样与伞骨仍保有细致轮廓。宽散的光从左前方落下，照亮面容与浅色布料，外缘则沉入暖棕色阴影。整体构图正式而精心平衡，在棕、奶油色与炭灰色的窄幅色域中重复圆形纸伞和纹理丰厚的竖向服装。
style_prompt_en: The photograph uses a restrained sepia range, fine grain, softly faded highlights, and shadow detail that compresses gently into deep brown. Repeated radial circles hover above elongated patterned forms, giving the frame a formal rhythm. Broad frontal light clarifies pale surfaces and faces without erasing the delicate texture of darker areas. Edges remain strongest around high-contrast contours and recede into a softly painted background elsewhere. Dense textile-like detail alternates with quiet open patches, and shallow staging keeps the forms close to one plane. The palette moves among cream, tobacco brown, umber, and charcoal, with no bright modern color. The overall effect is composed and archival, with tactile surface age and measured symmetry carrying the style.
style_prompt_zh: 照片使用克制的棕褐色域、细颗粒、轻微褪色的亮部，以及柔和压入深棕的阴影细节。重复的放射圆形悬在细长带纹样的形体上方，为画面建立正式节奏。宽泛的正面光澄清浅色表面，却不抹掉暗部区域的细腻肌理。高对比轮廓附近边缘最明确，其他地方则退入柔和绘制的背景。密集如织物的细节与安静的留空区域交替，浅层布置让各形体贴近同一平面。色彩在奶油色、烟草褐、深棕与炭灰之间移动，没有明亮的现代色。整体效果端正而带档案感，表面的旧化触感与有分寸的对称承担主要画风。
theme_en: Four women in patterned robes posed with paper parasols
theme_zh: 四位身着花纹长袍的女子与纸伞合影
name: Meiji Period photography
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
